summary: Simplify repository and website presentation while preserving the approved design and development limits. API impact: none — static copy/styles only.

guide.reason: Editorial cleanup and readability changes preserve all preview routes, labels and documented operator steps. No product behavior changes.

api.reason: Static files and repository prose have no changed client API, Controller operation, Core command or observed-state/result flow.
